title: Llama-GENBA-10B: A Trilingual Large Language Model for German, English and Bavarian

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance on reasoning and knowledge benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA, Winogrande) across English, German, and Bavarian to measure the mitigation of English-centric performance disparities.
